verdict.rationale: Bento documents an official Python SDK, with installation, configuration, a Google ADK extra, `bento.track_ai` wrapping and an OTel transport. For JS/TS, the docs only describe pointing a standard OpenTelemetry exporter at Bento "with no Bento package at all", so there is no evidence of an officially supported JS/TS SDK. Missing for 10: a documented first-party JS/TS SDK package, JS/TS installation and configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of either language's instrumentation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs

citations.quote: If you use **Google ADK**, install the extra so Bento can capture every call automatically
`init()` accepts `user_id`, `session_id`, and `tags` kwargs. Bento invokes them on every span
In TypeScript you can do this with no Bento package at all.
JavaScript's OpenTelemetry exporters can emit JSON, so you can send traces to Bento without installing any Bento package.
